If you use Claude Code in Cursor, check your computer now.

Two malicious extension updates attempted to install a persistent backdoor on Windows and macOS devices.

Removing the extension may not remove what they left behind.

Here’s how to check your machine: https://t.co/bHJ6B0zLop

If you installed either affected version:

1. Stop using the computer for sensitive work
2. Run Cursor’s official detection script
3. Remove the SSH key and persistence files
4. Rotate accessible credentials from a trusted device
5. Update to version 2.1.314 or later

Updating or uninstalling alone may not be enough.

Cursor published detection and remediation scripts for Windows and macOS.

Follow the official instructions here:

https://t.co/WUjUDgGw6H

Message threads are now in public beta on the Messages API.

The API caches your conversation on the server between turns, so instead of resending the full conversation, you send only new messages and the previous message ID, and Claude starts responding sooner. https://t.co/VeiehyqfIg

We recently integrated message threads in Claude Code. On requests with 500K to 1M tokens, median time to first token is about 35% lower.

In long conversations, the median request went from about 800 KB to 1.8 KB.

To use it, add the thread parameter and beta header to your requests. It's available on the Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude in Microsoft Foundry, and Claude on Google Cloud at standard token rates.

Full blog: https://t.co/x4NKvBLcSg

For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services to managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.
